title: Best Ps5 Pro (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were based on mentions in TechRadar, PCWorld, IGN, TheShortCut, and PCMag articles about the PS5 Pro.

verdict.line: Buy it if you want the highest graphics performance and extra storage, as it offers upgraded ray‑tracing, 8K upscaling and a 2 TB SSD. The main catch is its high price and lack of a disc drive.
